messages:
Anna Patel: Quick heads-up — I'm cleaning up the APAC residency language in the localization guide. Found two problems: the embeddings SDK snippet still points to the old regional header and the HK note is phrased as 'data stored in region' which is ambiguous for our residency policy. Can we coordinate a small PR?
Mike Chen: I can take the SDK snippet. Which file is it in? I think it's under docs/regions/embeddings.md
Anna Patel: Yep. It's the embeddings example. Current snippet uses `X-Region: apac` which we standardized to `X-Redwood-Region: ap-east-1` (see internal spec). Also the python example passes endpoint in a comment but not the header. Suggest replacing with this:

```python
# prefer explicit region header for residency-sensitive requests
headers = {"Authorization": "Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY", "X-Redwood-Region": "ap-east-1"}
client.embeddings.create(model="r-instruct-embed-1", input=[...], headers=headers)
```

Mike Chen: Nice. I'll open a tiny PR with that change and update the code block. Will also add a one-liner about fallback behavior when region is omitted.

Jess Rivera: Thanks — when you update the snippet please also add the legal footnote link about residency guarantees. We should avoid the phrase "stored in region" and use "processed and stored per residency settings". I'll paste the link: https://internal.redwood/legal/residency

Ben O'Neill: Also check the sample for embeddings in the README under the SDK folder. I spotted a broken link to the region codes table. It points to /docs/regions/codes but the live page is /docs/regions/reference-codes. Small link fix in same PR would be ideal.

Mike Chen: Good catch. I'll include link fix and update the table reference to the canonical path.

Anna Patel: Great. Two process notes: 1) tag the PR with `docs:region-residency` and `security-review` label (legal wants to glance at wording). 2) Add a changelog line in docs/CHANGELOG.md so customers see the clarified residency text.

Mike Chen: Will do. ETA for PR: within 2 hours. @Jess Rivera — want to do the legal quick look after I open it?

Jess Rivera: Yep, I'll review asap. If language needs tweaks I'll comment inline.

docs-bot: Link checker started for branch mike/embeddings-region-snippet — scanning changed files...

docs-bot: Link checker result: 1 fixed link (was /docs/regions/codes -> /docs/regions/reference-codes), 0 broken links remaining. All CI docs checks passed.

Anna Patel: Awesome — thanks everyone. After Jess signs off I'll merge. Please leave a short release note: "Clarify APAC residency language and update embeddings SDK header example." :thumbsup:

Mike Chen: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4289 — added snippet, footnote link, link fix, changelog line.

Jess Rivera: Reviewed and left two tiny wording suggestions. Approved after changes.

Anna Patel: Merged and backported to stable branch. Closing thread. Thanks! :rocket:
